exposure: oxytocin responsiveness (early reaction vs. later reaction)
cohort: A total of 1803 participants undergoing labor induction at Nantong Maternal and Child Health Hospital were divided into an early reaction to oxytocin group (1083) and a later reaction to oxytocin group (720).
finding: Later reaction to oxytocin was associated with lower 1-minute Apgar scores, an increased rate of neonatal intensive care unit admission, prolonged first and second phases of labor, and a higher incidence of postpartum hemorrhage.
